Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Barkly, Simpson, Tanami
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding, large hailstones and damaging winds in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Yuendumu, Ti Tree, Barrow Creek, Ampilatwatja, Willowra and south west Tanami District near WA border. Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Lasseter district and the warning for this district is CANCELLED. 102 km/h wind gust recorded at Alice Springs Airport at 4:36pm,
